translations.idiomatic: The Qing followed the same arrangement.

sentences.zh: 於陝、甘易番馬。

translations.literal: In Shaanxi and Gansu they exchanged for frontier horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaanxi and Gansu tea was traded for frontier horses.

sentences.zh: 他省則召商發引納課，間有商人赴部領銷者，亦有小販領於本籍州縣者。

translations.literal: Other provinces summoned merchants to issue licenses and pay duties; sometimes merchants went to the ministry to obtain and cancel licenses; small peddlers also obtained them from their native prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Other provinces licensed merchants and collected duties; some merchants obtained licenses from the ministry, others from local counties.

sentences.zh: 又有州縣承引，無商可給，發種茶園戶經紀者。

translations.literal: Some prefectures and counties undertook licenses when no merchant could be found, issuing them to tea-garden households and brokers.
translations.idiomatic: When no merchant was available, counties issued licenses to tea-garden households and brokers.

sentences.zh: 戶部寶泉局鑄刷引由，備書例款，直省預期請領，年辦年銷。

translations.literal: The Board of Revenue Baoquan Bureau cast and printed license forms, recording statutory provisions; provinces requested them in advance; issued and cancelled annually.
translations.idiomatic: The Board's Baoquan Bureau printed license forms with statutory provisions; provinces requested them annually for issue and cancellation.

sentences.zh: 茶百斤為一引，不及百斤謂之畸零，另給護帖。

translations.literal: One hundred jin of tea formed one license; less than one hundred jin was called fractional and received a separate transit permit.
translations.idiomatic: One license covered one hundred jin; fractional lots received a separate transit permit.

sentences.zh: 行過殘引皆繳部。

translations.literal: Used and remnant licenses were all surrendered to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Used licenses were surrendered to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 凡偽造茶引，或作假茶興販，及私與外國人買賣者，皆按律科罪。

translations.literal: All who forged tea licenses, trafficked in fake tea, or privately traded with foreigners were punished according to statute.
translations.idiomatic: Forging licenses, trafficking fake tea, and private trade with foreigners were all punishable by statute.

sentences.zh: 司茶之官，初沿明制。

translations.literal: Officials administering tea initially followed the Ming system.
translations.idiomatic: Tea officials initially followed the Ming system.

sentences.zh: 陝西設巡視茶馬御史五：西寧司駐西寧，洮州司駐岷州，河州司駐河州，庄浪司駐平番，甘州司駐蘭州。

translations.literal: Shaanxi established five tea-horse inspecting censors: Xining Bureau at Xining, Taozhou Bureau at Minzhou, Hezhou Bureau at Hezhou, Zhuanglang Bureau at Pingfan, Ganzhou Bureau at Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi had five tea-horse inspecting censors: Xining at Xining, Taozhou at Minzhou, Hezhou at Hezhou, Zhuanglang at Pingfan, and Ganzhou at Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋改差部員，又令甘肅巡撫兼轄，後歸陝甘總督管理。

translations.literal: Soon changed to dispatched ministry officials; then the Gansu governor was ordered to supervise jointly; later it came under the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: The post was later filled by dispatched ministry officials, then supervised by the Gansu governor, and finally by the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四川設鹽茶道。

translations.literal: Sichuan established a Salt and Tea Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan established a Salt and Tea Circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 江西設茶引批驗大使，隸江寧府。

translations.literal: Jiangxi established a tea-license inspection and verification commissioner subordinate to Jiangning prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi had a tea-license inspection commissioner under Jiangning prefecture.

sentences.zh: 歲徵之課，江蘇發引江寧批發所及荊溪縣屬張渚、湖汊兩巡檢司。

translations.literal: Annual levies: Jiangsu issued licenses at the Jiangning distribution office and the Zhangzhu and Hucha inspection offices under Jingxi county.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu issued licenses at the Jiangning distribution office and the Zhangzhu and Hucha inspection posts under Jingxi county.

sentences.zh: 安徽發引潛山、太湖、歙、休寧、黟、宣城、寧國、太平、貴池、青陽、銅陵、建德、蕪湖、六安、霍山、廣德、建平十七州縣。

translations.literal: Anhui issued licenses in seventeen prefectures and counties: Qianshan, Taihu, She, Xiuning, Yi, Xuancheng, Ningguo, Taiping, Guichi, Qingyang, Tongling, Jiande, Wuhu, Lu'an, Huoshan, Guangde, and Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui issued licenses in seventeen counties including Qianshan, Taihu, She, Xiuning, Yi, Xuancheng, Ningguo, Taiping, Guichi, Qingyang, Tongling, Jiande, Wuhu, Lu'an, Huoshan, Guangde, and Jianping.

sentences.zh: 江西發引徽商及各州縣小販。

translations.literal: Jiangxi issued licenses to Huizhou merchants and peddlers in various prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi issued licenses to Huizhou merchants and local peddlers.

sentences.zh: 此三省稅課，均於經過各關按則徵收。

translations.literal: These three provinces' duties were all collected at passing customs posts according to regulations.
translations.idiomatic: These three provinces collected duties at transit customs posts per regulations.

sentences.zh: 浙江由布政使委員給商，每引徵銀一錢，北新關徵稅銀二分九釐二毫八絲，匯入關稅報解。

translations.literal: Zhejiang's provincial administration commissioner delegated agents to issue to merchants; each license levied one mace of silver; Beixin Pass collected two fen nine li two hao eight si of tax silver, remitted into customs revenue reports.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's provincial commissioner issued licenses at one mace per license; Beixin Pass collected 2.928 fen of tax silver remitted as customs revenue.

sentences.zh: 又每歲辦上用及陵寢內廷黃茶共百一十餘簍，由辦引委員於所收茶引買價內辦解。

translations.literal: Each year over one hundred and ten baskets of imperial and mausoleum yellow tea were supplied, procured by license agents from tea-license purchase funds.
translations.idiomatic: Over 110 baskets of imperial and mausoleum yellow tea were supplied annually from license purchase funds.

sentences.zh: 湖北由咸寧、嘉魚、蒲圻、崇陽、通城、興國、通山七州縣領引，發種茶園戶經紀坐銷。

translations.literal: Hubei licenses were issued in seven prefectures and counties—Xianning, Jiayu, Puqi, Chongyang, Tongcheng, Xingguo, and Tongshan—distributed to tea-garden households and brokers for local sale.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei issued licenses in seven counties—Xianning, Jiayu, Puqi, Chongyang, Tongcheng, Xingguo, and Tongshan—to tea-garden households and brokers for local sale.

sentences.zh: 建始縣給商行銷。

translations.literal: Jianshi county issued to merchant firms for sale.
translations.idiomatic: Jianshi county issued licenses to merchant firms.

sentences.zh: 坐銷者每引徵銀一兩，行銷者徵稅二錢五分，課一錢二分五釐，共額徵稅課銀二百三十兩有奇。

translations.literal: Local sale: one tael per license; transit sale: tax two fen five li, duty one mace two fen five li; total scheduled tax and duty silver over 230 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Local sale paid one tael per license; transit sale paid 2.5 fen tax and 1.25 mace duty, totaling over 230 taels.

sentences.zh: 行茶到關，仍行報稅。

translations.literal: Tea in transit still reported tax at customs.
translations.idiomatic: Transit tea still paid tax at customs posts.

sentences.zh: 湖南發善化、湘陰、瀏陽、湘潭、益陽、攸、安化、邵陽、新化、武岡、巴陵、平江、臨湘、武陵、桃源、龍陽、沅江十七州縣行戶，共徵稅銀二百四十兩。

translations.literal: Hunan issued to transit merchants in seventeen prefectures and counties—Shanhua, Xiangyin, Liuyang, Xiangtan, Yiyang, You, Anhua, Shaoyang, Xinhua, Wugang, Baling, Pingjiang, Linxiang, Wuling, Taoyuan, Longyang, and Yuanjiang—total tax silver 240 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan issued to transit merchants in seventeen counties totaling 240 taels in tax.

sentences.zh: 陝、甘發西寧、甘州、庄浪三茶司，而西安、鳳翔、漢中、同州、榆林、延安、寧夏七府及神木廳亦分銷焉。

translations.literal: Shaanxi and Gansu issued through three tea bureaus at Xining, Ganzhou, and Zhuanglang; seven prefectures and Shenmu department also distributed.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi and Gansu issued through Xining, Ganzhou, and Zhuanglang tea bureaus, with seven prefectures and Shenmu also distributing.

sentences.zh: 每引納官茶五十斤，餘五十斤由商運售作本。

translations.literal: Each license delivered fifty jin of official tea; the remaining fifty jin merchants transported and sold as capital.
translations.idiomatic: Each license required fifty jin of official tea; merchants sold the remaining fifty jin as their margin.

sentences.zh: 每百斤為十篦，每篦二封，共徵本色茶十三萬六千四百八十篦。

translations.literal: Each hundred jin made ten baskets, each basket two packets; total natural tea levied 136,480 baskets.
translations.idiomatic: Each hundred jin equaled ten baskets of two packets each; total tea levy was 136,480 baskets.

sentences.zh: 改折之年，每封徵折銀三錢。

translations.literal: In years of commutation, each packet levied three mace of commuted silver.
translations.idiomatic: In commutation years each packet paid three mace of silver.

sentences.zh: 其原不交茶者，則徵價銀共五千七百三十兩有奇。

translations.literal: Those originally not delivering tea paid price silver totaling over 5,730 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Those exempt from tea delivery paid over 5,730 taels in commutation silver.

sentences.zh: 亦有不設引，止於本地行銷者，由各園戶納課，共徵銀五百三十兩有奇。

translations.literal: Some areas had no licenses, only local sale; garden households paid duties totaling over 530 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Areas without licenses collected over 530 taels from garden households selling locally.

sentences.zh: 四川有腹引、邊引、土引之分。

translations.literal: Sichuan had interior licenses, frontier licenses, and native-territory licenses.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan had interior, frontier, and native-territory license types.

sentences.zh: 腹引行內地，邊引行邊地，土引行土司。

translations.literal: Interior licenses circulated inland, frontier licenses on the frontier, native licenses in chieftain territories.
translations.idiomatic: Interior licenses served inland markets, frontier licenses the borderlands, native licenses tribal territories.

sentences.zh: 而邊引又分三道，其行銷打箭爐者，曰南路邊引；

translations.literal: Frontier licenses further divided into three routes: those sold at Dajianlu were called southern frontier licenses;
translations.idiomatic: Frontier licenses divided into three routes: those for Dajianlu were southern frontier licenses;

sentences.zh: 行銷松潘廳者，曰西路邊引；

translations.literal: those sold at Songpan department were western frontier licenses;
translations.idiomatic: those for Songpan were western frontier licenses;

sentences.zh: 行銷邛州者，曰邛州邊引。

translations.literal: those sold at Qiongzhou were Qiongzhou frontier licenses.
translations.idiomatic: those for Qiongzhou were Qiongzhou frontier licenses.

sentences.zh: 皆納課稅，共課銀萬四千三百四十兩，稅銀四萬九千一百七十兩，各有奇。

translations.literal: All paid duties and taxes; total duty silver 14,340 taels odd, tax silver 49,170 taels odd.
translations.idiomatic: All paid duties totaling about 14,340 taels and taxes about 49,170 taels.

sentences.zh: 雲南徵稅銀九百六十兩。

translations.literal: Yunnan collected tax silver of 960 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan collected 960 taels in tax.

sentences.zh: 貴州課稅銀六十餘兩。

translations.literal: Guizhou duty and tax silver over 60 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou collected over 60 taels in duties and taxes.

sentences.zh: 凡請引於部，例收紙價，每道以三釐三毫為率。

translations.literal: All requesting licenses from the ministry paid paper cost at the rate of three li three hao per license.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry licenses charged paper fees at 3.3 hao per license.

sentences.zh: 盛京、直隸、河南、山東、山西、福建、廣東、廣西均不頒引，故無課。

translations.literal: Shengjing, Zhili, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Fujian, Guangdong, and Guangxi did not issue licenses, hence no duties.
translations.idiomatic: Shengjing, Zhili, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Fujian, Guangdong, and Guangxi issued no licenses and collected no tea duties.

sentences.zh: 惟茶商到境，由經過關口輸稅，或略收落地稅，附關稅造銷，或匯入雜稅報部。

translations.literal: Only when tea merchants arrived, passing customs posts paid tax, or slight local landing tax was collected, attached to customs reports, or remitted as miscellaneous tax to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Tea merchants paid transit customs, minor landing taxes attached to customs reports, or miscellaneous taxes remitted to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 此嘉慶前行茶事例也。

translations.literal: These were the tea precedents before Jiaqing.
translations.idiomatic: Such were the tea regulations before Jiaqing.

sentences.zh: 厥後泰西諸國通商，茶務因之一變。

translations.literal: Thereafter Western nations traded, and the tea business changed accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Western trade thereafter transformed the tea business.

sentences.zh: 其市場大者有三：曰漢口，曰上海，曰福州。

translations.literal: The great markets were three: Hankou, Shanghai, and Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The three major markets were Hankou, Shanghai, and Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 漢口之茶，來自湖南、江西、安徽，合本省所產，溯漢水以運於河南、陝西、青海、新疆。

translations.literal: Hankou tea came from Hunan, Jiangxi, and Anhui, combined with local production, shipped up the Han River to Henan, Shaanxi, Qinghai, and Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hankou tea came from Hunan, Jiangxi, and Anhui plus local production, shipped up the Han to Henan, Shaanxi, Qinghai, and Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 其輸至俄羅斯者，皆磚茶也。

translations.literal: What was exported to Russia was all brick tea.
translations.idiomatic: Exports to Russia were all brick tea.

sentences.zh: 上海之茶尤盛，自本省所產外，多有湖廣、江西、安徽、浙江、福建諸茶。

translations.literal: Shanghai tea was especially flourishing; besides local production, much came from Huguang, Jiangxi, Anhui, Zhejiang, and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai was the largest market, drawing tea from Huguang, Jiangxi, Anhui, Zhejiang, and Fujian as well as local production.

sentences.zh: 江西、安徽紅綠茶多售於歐、美各國。

translations.literal: Jiangxi and Anhui red and green tea mostly sold to European and American countries.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi and Anhui red and green tea sold mainly to Europe and America.

sentences.zh: 浙江紹興茶輸至美利堅，寧波茶輸至日本。

translations.literal: Zhejiang Shaoxing tea exported to the United States; Ningbo tea to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing tea went to the United States; Ningbo tea to Japan.

sentences.zh: 福州紅茶多輸至美洲及南洋群島。

translations.literal: Fuzhou black tea mostly exported to the Americas and the South Seas islands.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou black tea exported mainly to the Americas and Southeast Asia.

sentences.zh: 此三市場外，又有廣州、天津、芝罘三所，洋商亦麕集焉。

translations.literal: Beyond these three markets were also Guangzhou, Tianjin, and Zhifu, where foreign merchants also gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou, Tianjin, and Zhifu also attracted foreign merchants.

sentences.zh: 蓋茶之性喜燠惡寒，喜濕惡燥，又必避慓烈之風，最適於中國。

translations.literal: Tea by nature loves warmth and hates cold, loves moisture and hates dryness, and must avoid fierce wind—it is most suited to China.
translations.idiomatic: Tea thrives in warmth and moisture and cannot endure cold, dryness, or fierce wind—conditions found chiefly in China.

sentences.zh: 泰西商務雖盛，然非其土所宜，不能不仰給於我國，用此駸駸遍及全球矣。

translations.literal: Western commerce was flourishing, yet their soil was unsuitable; they could not but depend on our country; thus it gradually spread throughout the globe.
translations.idiomatic: Though Western commerce flourished, their lands could not grow tea; they depended on China, and Chinese tea spread worldwide.

sentences.zh: 其業此者，有總商，有散商。

translations.literal: Those in this trade included chief merchants and scattered merchants.
translations.idiomatic: The trade included wholesale merchants and retailers.

sentences.zh: 領引後，行銷各有定域。

translations.literal: After obtaining licenses, each had a fixed sales territory.
translations.idiomatic: Licensed merchants each had fixed sales territories.

sentences.zh: 亦有兼行票法者，如四川自乾隆五十二年開辦堰工茶票後，名目甚繁，然第行於產多或銷暢之區，非遍及各州縣也。

translations.literal: Some also used ticket methods; as in Sichuan after Qianlong year 52 when irrigation-work tea tickets were introduced, names were very numerous, yet they operated only in productive or brisk-selling regions, not in every prefecture and county.
translations.idiomatic: Some regions used ticket systems; Sichuan introduced irrigation-work tea tickets in Qianlong 52 with many variants, but only in productive or high-volume areas.

sentences.zh: 惟甘商舊分東、西二櫃，東櫃多籍隸山西、陝西，西櫃則回民充之。

translations.literal: Only Gansu merchants were formerly divided into eastern and western guilds; the eastern guild were mostly from Shanxi and Shaanxi; the western guild were Hui Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu merchants were formerly divided into eastern and western guilds: eastern merchants from Shanxi and Shaanxi, western merchants mostly Hui.

sentences.zh: 自咸豐中回匪滋事，繼以盜賊充斥，兩櫃均無人承課。

translations.literal: From mid-Xianfeng when Hui rebels caused trouble, followed by bandits everywhere, neither guild had anyone to undertake the tax contract.
translations.idiomatic: After Hui rebellions in mid-Xianfeng and widespread banditry, neither guild could fulfill tax contracts.

sentences.zh: 總督左宗棠勘定全省，乃奏定章程，以票代引。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zuo Zongtang surveyed the whole province and memorialized fixed regulations, substituting tickets for licenses.
translations.idiomatic: After pacifying the province, Governor-General Zuo Zongtang memorialized to replace licenses with tickets.

sentences.zh: 遴選新商採運湖茶，是曰南櫃。

translations.literal: New merchants were selected to procure and transport Huguang tea; this was called the southern guild.
translations.idiomatic: New merchants were selected to transport Huguang tea as the southern guild.

sentences.zh: 時領票止八百餘張。

translations.literal: At the time only over 800 tickets were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Initially only about 800 tickets were issued.

sentences.zh: 嗣定為三年一案，領票准加不準減。

translations.literal: Later fixed as three-year cycles; ticket quotas might increase but not decrease.
translations.idiomatic: A three-year cycle was adopted; ticket quotas could increase but not decrease.

sentences.zh: 計自光緒十三年至二十七年，逐案加增。

translations.literal: From Guangxu year 13 to year 27, each cycle increased.
translations.idiomatic: From Guangxu 13 to 27 quotas increased each cycle.

sentences.zh: 三十年，又於湖票外更行銷伊、塔之晉票。

translations.literal: In year 30, beyond Huguang tickets, Shanxi tickets for Ili and Tacheng were also circulated.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 Shanxi tickets for Ili and Tacheng were added beyond Huguang tickets.

sentences.zh: 迄於宣統二年，茶務日盛。

translations.literal: By Xuantong year 2 the tea business daily flourished.
translations.idiomatic: By Xuantong 2 the tea trade was thriving.

sentences.zh: 茶之與鹽，辦法略相似。

translations.literal: Tea and salt were administered in broadly similar ways.
translations.idiomatic: Tea administration resembled salt administration in broad outline.

sentences.zh: 惟鹽為歲入大宗，故掌國計者第附於鹽而總核之。

translations.literal: Only salt was a major annual revenue source, so those managing state finance merely attached tea to salt for aggregate accounting.
translations.idiomatic: Salt was a major revenue source, so fiscal officials grouped tea revenue under salt accounts.

sentences.zh: 其始但有課稅，除江、浙額引由各關徵收無定額外，他省每歲多者千餘兩，少祗數百兩或數十兩。

translations.literal: At first there were only duties; except Jiangsu and Zhejiang fixed quotas collected at customs without fixed amounts, other provinces yearly collected at most over 1,000 taels, at least several hundred or several tens.
translations.idiomatic: Initially only duties were collected; except Jiangsu and Zhejiang with variable customs collection, other provinces yielded at most over 1,000 taels annually, some only hundreds or tens.

sentences.zh: 即陝、甘、四川號為邊引，亦不滿十萬金。

translations.literal: Even Shaanxi, Gansu, and Sichuan, called frontier licenses, did not reach 100,000 taels of gold.
translations.idiomatic: Even Shaanxi, Gansu, and Sichuan frontier licenses yielded less than 100,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 咸豐以來，各省次第行釐，光緒十二年，福建冊報至十九萬餘兩，他省款亦漸多，未幾收數復絀。

translations.literal: Since Xianfeng provinces successively imposed likin; in Guangxu year 12 Fujian reported over 190,000 taels; other provinces' receipts also gradually increased; soon collections again fell short.
translations.idiomatic: Since Xianfeng provinces imposed likin; Fujian reported over 190,000 taels in Guangxu 12; other provinces' receipts grew but soon declined again.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年豫算表所載，茶稅特百三十餘萬而已。

translations.literal: The Xuantong year 3 budget table recorded tea tax at only a little over 1.3 million.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuantong 3 budget listed tea tax at only about 1.3 million taels.

sentences.zh: 順治初元，定茶馬事例。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, tea-horse precedents were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In early Shunzhi tea-horse regulations were established.

sentences.zh: 上馬給茶篦十二，中馬給九，下馬給七。

translations.literal: Superior horses received twelve baskets of tea, medium nine, inferior seven.
translations.idiomatic: Superior horses received twelve baskets of tea, medium horses nine, inferior horses seven.

sentences.zh: 二年，差御史轄五茶馬司。

translations.literal: In year 2 a censor was dispatched to supervise five tea-horse bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 a censor was dispatched to supervise five tea-horse bureaus.

sentences.zh: 時商人多越境私販，番族利其值賤，趨之若鶩。

translations.literal: At the time merchants often crossed borders to sell privately; frontier peoples profited from low prices and flocked like ducks.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants often smuggled tea across borders; frontier peoples flocked to buy at low prices.

sentences.zh: 兼番僧馳驛往來，夾帶私茶出關，吏不能詰。

translations.literal: Moreover Tibetan monks traveled by courier post, smuggling private tea through passes; clerks could not investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan monks traveling by courier also smuggled tea through passes beyond official control.

sentences.zh: 戶部奏言：「陝西以茶易馬，明有照給金牌勘合之例。

translations.literal: The Board of Revenue memorialized: "Shaanxi exchanges tea for horses; the Ming had precedents of issuing gold plaques and tallies."
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Revenue memorialized: "Shaanxi trades tea for horses; the Ming issued gold plaques and tallies for this purpose."

sentences.zh: 今可勿用，但定價值。

translations.literal: "These need not be used now; only fix the price."
translations.idiomatic: "These need no longer be used; fix prices instead."

sentences.zh: 至番僧所至，如官吏縱容收買私茶，聽巡按御史參究。

translations.literal: "As for where Tibetan monks arrive, if officials connive at purchasing private tea, let touring censors investigate and punish."
translations.idiomatic: "Where Tibetan monks travel, officials who connive at private tea purchases shall be investigated by touring censors."

sentences.zh: 」茶馬御史廖攀龍又言：「茶馬舊額萬一千八十八匹，崇禎三年增解二千匹，請永行蠲免。

translations.literal: " Tea-horse censor Liao Panlong also said: "The old tea-horse quota was 11,088 horses; in Chongzhen year 3 an additional 2,000 were required; request permanent exemption."
translations.idiomatic: Tea-horse censor Liao Panlong also memorialized: "The old quota was 11,088 horses; Chongzhen 3 added 2,000; I request permanent exemption from the addition."

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，命巡視茶馬滿、漢御史各一，直隸河寶營地當張家口之西，明時鄂爾多斯部落曾於此交易茶馬，旋封閉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, one Manchu and one Han tea-horse inspecting censor were appointed each; Zhili's Hebao garrison camp lay west of Zhangjiakou; in Ming times the Ordos tribes had traded tea and horses here, but it was soon closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, one Manchu and one Han tea-horse censor were appointed. The Hebao garrison camp in Zhili, west of Zhangjiakou, had been a Ming-era tea-horse market for the Ordos tribes before it was shut down.

sentences.zh: 至是，戶部差理事官履勘，以狀聞。

translations.literal: At this time the Board of Revenue dispatched an administrative official to inspect on site and report the facts.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Revenue then sent an official to inspect the site and report back.

sentences.zh: 諭仍准互市。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that border trade still be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The court authorized the market to reopen.

sentences.zh: 七年，以甘肅舊例，大引篦茶，官商均分，小引納稅三分入官，七分給商。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, following Gansu's old practice, large licenses were for brick tea divided equally between government and merchants; on small licenses three-tenths of the tax went to government and seven-tenths to merchants.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, under Gansu's old rules, large licenses covered brick tea split evenly between the state and merchants; on small licenses, thirty percent of the levy went to the government and seventy percent to the merchant.

sentences.zh: 諭嗣後各引均由部發，照大引例，以為中馬之用。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that thereafter all licenses be issued by the ministry, following the large-license precedent, for use in horse procurement.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter all licenses were to be issued by the Board of Revenue under the large-license rule for horse procurement.

sentences.zh: 又舊例大引附六十篦，小引附六十七斤。

translations.literal: The old practice also allowed sixty bricks of supplementary tea on a large license and sixty-seven jin on a small license.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rule, a large license also permitted sixty supplementary tea bricks and a small license sixty-seven jin of supplementary tea.

sentences.zh: 定為每茶千斤，概准附百四十斤，聽商自賣。

translations.literal: It was fixed that for every thousand jin of tea, one hundred forty jin of supplementary tea was generally permitted, and merchants were allowed to sell it themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The rule was set at one hundred forty jin of supplementary tea per thousand jin of licensed tea, which merchants could sell on their own.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以甘肅所中之馬既足，命陳茶變價充餉。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, because the horses procured in Gansu were already sufficient, aged tea was ordered sold for cash to supply pay.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, with Gansu's horse quota already met, surplus aged tea was ordered sold for cash to cover military pay.

sentences.zh: 十四年，復以廣寧、開成、黑水、安定、清安、萬安、武安七監馬蕃，命私馬私茶沒入變價。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because horses at the seven pastures of Guangning, Kaicheng, Heishui, Anding, Qing'an, Wan'an, and Wu'an had again multiplied, private horses and private tea were ordered confiscated and sold.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, with herds again overflowing at the seven pastures of Guangning, Kaicheng, Heishui, Anding, Qing'an, Wan'an, and Wu'an, private horses and smuggled tea were confiscated and sold off.

sentences.zh: 原留中馬支用者，悉改折充餉。

translations.literal: Tea originally kept for horse procurement was all changed to cash commutation for pay.
translations.idiomatic: Tea previously reserved for horse procurement was converted entirely to cash payments for military pay.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從達賴喇嘛及根都台吉請，於雲南北勝州以馬易茶。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, acceding to requests from the Dalai Lama and Gendu Taiji, horses were exchanged for tea at Beisheng Prefecture in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, at the request of the Dalai Lama and Gendu Taiji, a horse-for-tea market was opened at Beisheng Prefecture in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，遂裁陝西苑馬各監，開茶馬市於北勝州。

translations.literal: In Kangxi year 4, the various Shaanxi horse pasture superintendencies were abolished and a tea-horse market was opened at Beisheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4, Shaanxi's horse pasture offices were abolished and the tea-horse market was moved to Beisheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七年，裁茶馬御史，歸甘肅巡撫管理。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the tea-horse censors were abolished and the matter was placed under the Gansu governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, the tea-horse censors were abolished and tea affairs passed to the Gansu governor.

sentences.zh: 十九年，以軍需急，加福建茶課銀三百五十九兩，至二十六年豁免，併除湖廣新增茶稅銀。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, because military needs were urgent, Fujian's tea duty was increased by 359 taels of silver; by the twenty-sixth year this was exempted, and newly added Huguang tea tax silver was also removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, an emergency levy of 359 taels was added to Fujian's tea duty; by the twenty-sixth year it was waived, along with newly imposed Huguang tea taxes.

sentences.zh: 時四川產茶多，其用漸廣，戶部議增引，迄康熙末，天全土司、雅州、邛、榮經、名山、新繁、大邑、灌縣並有所增。

translations.literal: At the time Sichuan produced much tea and its use gradually spread; the Board of Revenue debated increasing licenses, and by the end of Kangxi, Tianquan native office, Yazhou, Qiong, Rongjing, Mingshan, Xinfan, Dayi, and Guanxian all received increases.
translations.idiomatic: As Sichuan tea production and consumption grew, the Board of Revenue approved more licenses; by the end of Kangxi, quotas had been raised for Tianquan, Yazhou, Qiong, Rongjing, Mingshan, Xinfan, Dayi, Guanxian, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，刑科給事中裘元佩言洮、岷諸處額茶三十餘萬篦，可中馬萬匹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Supervising Secretary Qiu Yuanpei of the Penalty Section said that the allotted tea of more than 300,000 bricks in the Tao and Min regions could procure 10,000 horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, Supervising Secretary Qiu Yuanpei of the Penalty Section reported that the allotted tea of more than 300,000 bricks in the Tao and Min districts could supply 10,000 horses.

sentences.zh: 陳茶每年帶銷，又可中數萬匹。

translations.literal: Aged tea sold from stock each year could procure several tens of thousands more horses.
translations.idiomatic: Annual sales from aged stock could supply tens of thousands more horses.

sentences.zh: 請遣員專管。

translations.literal: He requested that a commissioner be dispatched to manage it exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that a dedicated official be appointed to oversee the trade.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，遂差部員督理茶馬事務。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, a ministry official was dispatched to supervise tea-horse affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, a Board of Revenue commissioner was sent to oversee tea-horse affairs.

sentences.zh: 四十年，以陝西私茶充斥，令嚴查往來民人，凡攜帶私茶十斤以下勿問，其馱載十斤以上無官引者論罪。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, because private tea filled Shaanxi, strict inspection of travelers was ordered; those carrying ten jin or less of private tea were not questioned, but those transporting more than ten jin without an official license were punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year, with smuggled tea flooding Shaanxi, travelers were strictly inspected: private tea of ten jin or less was ignored, but loads above ten jin without an official license were penalized.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，以奸商恃有前例，皆分帶零運，私販轉多，飭照舊緝捕，停差部員，仍歸甘肅巡撫兼理。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, because unscrupulous merchants relied on the earlier precedent and all split loads for piecemeal transport, private trafficking increased; orders were issued to enforce capture as before, ministry commissioners were stopped, and affairs again came under the Gansu governor jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, merchants exploited the ten-jin exemption by splitting loads, and smuggling increased; enforcement was tightened, the ministry commissioner was withdrawn, and tea affairs reverted to the Gansu governor.

sentences.zh: 自康熙三十二年，因西寧五司所存茶篦年久浥爛，經部議准變賣。

translations.literal: From Kangxi year 32, because tea bricks stored by the Five Bureaus of Xining had long grown moldy from damp, the ministry deliberated and approved selling them off.
translations.idiomatic: From Kangxi 32, moldy tea bricks long stored by the Five Bureaus of Xining were approved for sale by the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 後又以蘭州無馬可中，將甘州舊積之茶，在五鎮俸餉內，銀七茶三，按成搭放。

translations.literal: Later, because no horses could be procured at Lanzhou, old tea accumulated at Ganzhou was apportioned within the pay of the five garrisons, seven parts silver and three parts tea, distributed by fixed ratio.
translations.idiomatic: Later, with no horses available at Lanzhou, old tea stockpiled at Ganzhou was used to pay the five garrisons in a seven-to-three mix of silver and tea.

sentences.zh: 尋又定西寧等處停止易馬，每新茶一篦折銀四錢，陳茶折六錢，充餉。

translations.literal: Soon it was also fixed that Xining and other places should stop exchanging for horses; each brick of new tea was commuted at four mace of silver and aged tea at six mace, to supply pay.
translations.idiomatic: Horse exchange at Xining and elsewhere was then halted; new tea was commuted at four mace per brick and aged tea at six mace to cover military pay.

sentences.zh: 至六十一年，復增西寧、庄浪、岷州、河州茶引，各處所存舊茶，悉令變賣。

translations.literal: By the sixty-first year, tea licenses at Xining, Zhuanglang, Minzhou, and Hezhou were again increased, and old tea stored in each place was all ordered sold off.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixty-first year, tea licenses were expanded at Xining, Zhuanglang, Minzhou, and Hezhou, and all remaining old stock was ordered sold.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，遂議自康熙六十一年始，五年內全徵本色，五年後即將舊茶變賣。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng year 3, it was deliberated that starting from Kangxi year 61, payment in kind would be collected in full for five years, and after five years old tea would be sold off.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3, it was decided that from Kangxi 61, tea duties would be collected in kind for five years, after which old stock would be sold off.

sentences.zh: 嗣是出陳易新，總以五年為率。

translations.literal: Thereafter old stock was rotated out and new tea brought in, always on a five-year cycle.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter aged tea was rotated out and replaced with new stock on a five-year cycle.

sentences.zh: 四年，定陝西行茶，改令產茶地方官給發船票，照商人引目茶數開明，如於部引外搭行印票，及附茶不遵定額者，照私鹽律論，查驗失察故縱，均加處分。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Shaanxi tea transport was fixed: local officials in tea-producing districts were ordered to issue shipping permits, stating the merchant's licensed tea according to the license; if extra stamped permits were issued beyond the ministry license, or supplementary tea did not follow the fixed quota, punishment followed the private-salt statute; officials who failed inspection or deliberately connived were also penalized.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Shaanxi tea transport rules were revised: producing districts issued shipping permits matching licensed quantities; extra permits or excess supplementary tea were punished like smuggled salt, and negligent or conniving inspectors were penalized as well.

sentences.zh: 八年，命陝西商運官茶，於舊例每百斤准附帶十四斤外，再加耗茶十四斤。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Shaanxi merchants transporting official tea were ordered, beyond the old allowance of fourteen jin of supplementary tea per hundred jin, to receive an additional fourteen jin of wastage tea.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Shaanxi merchants carrying official tea were granted an additional fourteen jin of wastage allowance on top of the usual fourteen jin per hundred jin.

sentences.zh: 又諭：「四川茶稅皆論園論樹，夫樹有大小，園有寬狹，豈能一致？

translations.literal: An edict also said: "Sichuan tea taxes are all assessed by garden or by tree; trees differ in size and gardens in breadth—how can they be uniform?"
translations.idiomatic: An edict also noted: "Sichuan's tea tax is levied by garden or by tree, but trees and gardens vary widely—how can one rate fit all?"

sentences.zh: 若據以為額，未得其平。

translations.literal: "If this is taken as the quota, fairness is not achieved."
translations.idiomatic: "Using that as the standard would be unfair."

sentences.zh: 應照斤兩收納，著該撫詳議。

translations.literal: "It should be collected by weight in jin and liang; let the governor deliberate in detail."
translations.idiomatic: "Collect by weight instead, and let the governor submit a detailed plan."

sentences.zh: 」尋議：「舊例每斤徵課二釐五毫，今但徵四絲九忽有奇，前後懸絕，應酌減其半，無論邊、土、腹引，俱納銀一釐二毫五絲。

translations.literal: " Soon deliberation followed: "Under the old rule two and a half li of duty were levied per jin; now only four si nine hu and a fraction are collected—the gap between old and new is extreme; half should be reduced from the rate; whether frontier, local, or interior licenses, all should pay one liang two hao five si of silver."
translations.idiomatic: A follow-up proposal held: "The old rate was two and a half li per jin, but the current levy is only four si nine hu—a huge gap. Cut the rate in half: all frontier, local, and interior licenses should pay one liang two hao five si of silver per jin."

sentences.zh: 」時川茶行銷，引尚不敷，於是復增，各府、州、縣再行給發。

translations.literal: " At the time Sichuan tea sales still lacked sufficient licenses, so quotas were again increased and reissued in each prefecture, department, and county.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan tea sales still outran available licenses, so quotas were raised again and reissued across the province.

sentences.zh: 九年，命西寧五司復行中馬法。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the Five Bureaus of Xining were ordered to restore the horse-procurement system.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, the Five Bureaus of Xining resumed horse procurement.

sentences.zh: 十年，又命中馬應見發茶。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, it was again ordered that tea for horse procurement should be issued from existing stock.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, tea for horse procurement was again to be drawn from stock on hand.

sentences.zh: 時安徽亦增引，照四川例，以餘引暫存司庫，遇不敷時，配給行運。

translations.literal: At the time Anhui also increased licenses; following the Sichuan precedent, surplus licenses were temporarily kept in the provincial treasury and allocated for transport when quotas fell short.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui also raised its quotas; following Sichuan's example, surplus licenses were held in treasury and issued when demand exceeded supply.

sentences.zh: 十三年，復停甘肅中馬。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Gansu horse procurement was again halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, horse procurement in Gansu was suspended again.

sentences.zh: 始定雲南茶法，以七斤為一筒，三十二筒為一引，照例收稅。

translations.literal: Yunnan's tea law was first fixed: seven jin formed one tube, thirty-two tubes one license, and tax was collected according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's tea regulations were established at seven jin per tube and thirty-two tubes per license, with duties collected under the usual rules.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，令甘肅官茶改徵折色，每篦輸銀五錢。

translations.literal: In Qianlong year 1, Gansu official tea was ordered converted to silver commutation, five mace of silver per brick.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, Gansu official tea duties were commuted to silver at five mace per brick.

sentences.zh: 時西寧五司陳茶充牣，令每封減價二錢，刻期變賣。

translations.literal: At the time aged tea at the Five Bureaus of Xining overflowed storage; each package was ordered reduced two mace in price and sold off by a fixed deadline.
translations.idiomatic: With aged tea overflowing at the Five Bureaus of Xining, each package was discounted two mace and ordered sold by deadline.

sentences.zh: 二年，以江西南昌等三十二州縣地不產茶，四川成都、彭、灌等縣滯銷，其引或停或減，並豁除課銀。

translations.literal: In the second year, because thirty-two prefectures and counties including Nanchang in Jiangxi produced no tea, and Chengdu, Peng, Guan, and other counties in Sichuan sold poorly, their licenses were suspended or reduced and duty silver was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, licenses were suspended or cut and duties waived in thirty-two Jiangxi counties that produced no tea and in Sichuan districts such as Chengdu, Peng, and Guan where sales had stalled.

sentences.zh: 七年，免甘肅地震處之課，乃命西寧五司徵本色。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, duties in Gansu earthquake districts were exempted, and the Five Bureaus of Xining were then ordered to collect payment in kind.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, tea duties were waived in earthquake-stricken parts of Gansu, and the Five Bureaus of Xining resumed collection in kind.

sentences.zh: 八年，免四川天全所欠乾隆七年前之羨餘截角，成都、彭、灌等縣之未完銀兩。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Tianquan in Sichuan was exempted from surplus corner-cutoffs owed before Qianlong year 7, and unpaid silver in Chengdu, Peng, Guan, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Tianquan was forgiven surplus license fees owed before Qianlong 7, along with unpaid duties in Chengdu, Peng, Guan, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 十一年，甘肅巡撫黃廷桂奏言：「西寧、河州、庄浪三司，番、民錯處，惟茶是賴。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Gansu Governor Huang Tinggui memorialized: "At the three bureaus of Xining, Hezhou, and Zhuanglang, frontier peoples and commoners live intermixed and depend on tea alone."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Gansu Governor Huang Tinggui reported: "At Xining, Hezhou, and Zhuanglang, where frontier peoples and settlers live side by side, tea is indispensable."

sentences.zh: 邇年以糧易茶，計用茶六萬五千五百餘封，易雜糧三萬八千一百餘石，請著為例。

translations.literal: "In recent years grain has been exchanged for tea; tea used totaled more than 65,500 packages, exchanged for more than 38,100 shi of miscellaneous grain; request that this be fixed as precedent."
translations.idiomatic: "In recent years more than 65,500 packages of tea have been traded for over 38,100 shi of grain; I ask that this arrangement be made permanent."

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十三年，定甘肅應徵茶封，每年收二成本色、八成折色，並申明水陸各路運商驗引截角法，推行安徽、浙江、四川、雲南、貴州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Gansu's required tea packages were fixed: each year twenty percent was collected in kind and eighty percent in silver commutation; methods of verifying licenses and corner-cutoffs for merchants by land and water were also clarified and extended to Anhui, Zhejiang, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Gansu tea duties were set at twenty percent in kind and eighty percent in silver, with license verification rules for land and water transport extended to Anhui, Zhejiang, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，從甘肅巡撫吳達善言，命西寧五司茶封，照康熙三十七年例，搭放各營俸餉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, acceding to Gansu Governor Wu Dashan, tea packages of the Five Bureaus of Xining were ordered apportioned for garrison pay according to the Kangxi year 37 precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, following Gansu Governor Wu Dashan, tea packages from the Five Bureaus of Xining were again used to pay garrison troops under the Kangxi 37 rule.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，吳達善又言：「甘省茶課向為中馬設。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Wu Dashan again said: "Gansu's tea duties were originally established for horse procurement."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, Wu Dashan added: "Gansu's tea levies were originally meant for horse procurement."

sentences.zh: 今其制已停，在甘、庄二司地處沖衢，西河二司附近青海，猶有銷路，惟洮司偏僻，商銷茶斤，歷年俱改別司售賣，而交官茶封，仍歸洮庫，往往積至數十萬封，始請疏銷。

translations.literal: "Now that system has ceased; Gan and Zhuang Bureaus stand at crossroads, and Xi and He Bureaus lie near Qinghai and still have sales routes; only Taozhou Bureau is remote—merchants' tea sales year after year are all diverted to other bureaus for sale, yet official tea packages submitted still go to the Taozhou storehouse, often accumulating to several hundred thousand packages before gradual sale is requested."
translations.idiomatic: "That system has ended. Gan and Zhuang stand on major routes, and Xi and He near Qinghai still have markets; only Taozhou is remote. Merchants sell through other bureaus, yet official tea packages still go to Taozhou's warehouse, where stock often reaches hundreds of thousands before a clearance sale is requested."

sentences.zh: 應將洮司額頒茶引，改歸甘、庄二司給商徵課，俟洮司庫貯搭餉完日，即行裁汰。

translations.literal: "Taozhou Bureau's allotted tea licenses should be transferred to Gan and Zhuang Bureaus to issue to merchants and collect duties; once Taozhou's stored tea for apportioned pay is exhausted, it should be abolished at once."
translations.idiomatic: "Taozhou's license quota should be reassigned to Gan and Zhuang for merchant issue and tax collection; once Taozhou's stored tea for pay is cleared out, the bureau should be abolished."

sentences.zh: 二十七年，陝甘總督楊應琚復條上疏銷事宜四：「一，官茶應改徵折價也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Yang Yingju again submitted four items on clearing stock: "First, official tea should be converted to cash commutation."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, Governor-General Yang Yingju proposed four measures to clear surplus stock, beginning: "First, official tea should be commuted to cash."

sentences.zh: 查甘肅庫貯官茶，向例如存積過多，改徵折色。

translations.literal: "Investigation shows that when official tea stored in Gansu warehouses accumulated excessively, collection was changed to silver commutation according to precedent."
translations.idiomatic: "When Gansu's official tea stores grew excessive, precedent allowed commutation to silver."

sentences.zh: 今五司庫內，自乾隆七年至二十四年，已存百五十餘萬封。

translations.literal: "Now within the Five Bureaus' storehouses, from Qianlong year 7 to year 24, more than 1.5 million packages have already been stored."
translations.idiomatic: "By Qianlong 24, the Five Bureaus already held more than 1.5 million packages accumulated since Qianlong 7."

sentences.zh: 經前撫臣吳達善奏准每封作價三錢，搭放兵餉，已搭放四十餘萬封。

translations.literal: "Former Governor Wu Dashan memorialized and obtained approval to value each package at three mace and apportion it for soldiers' pay; more than 400,000 packages have already been apportioned."
translations.idiomatic: "Former Governor Wu Dashan had them valued at three mace each for military pay; more than 400,000 packages have already been distributed that way."

sentences.zh: 在市肆官茶日多，非十年之久，不能全數疏銷。

translations.literal: "Official tea in the markets grows daily; without ten years, the whole amount cannot be fully cleared."
translations.idiomatic: "Official tea is flooding the market; clearing it all would take at least ten years."

sentences.zh: 且每年商人又增配二十四萬封，商茶既多，官茶益滯。

translations.literal: "Moreover each year merchants are additionally allotted 240,000 packages; as merchant tea increases, official tea stagnates all the more."
translations.idiomatic: "Merchants are also allotted another 240,000 packages each year, which only adds to the glut of official tea."

sentences.zh: 莫若將商交二成官茶五萬四千餘封，照例每封徵折價三錢，俟陳茶銷售將完，再徵本色。

translations.literal: "Better to take the 54,000-odd packages of the twenty percent official tea merchants submit, collect cash commutation at three mace per package as before, and after aged tea sales are nearly finished, collect payment in kind again."
translations.idiomatic: "Better to commute the 54,000-odd packages of the twenty-percent official tea levy at three mace each, and resume collection in kind once aged stock is cleared."

sentences.zh: 一，商茶應准減配也。

translations.literal: "Second, merchant tea allotments should be permitted to be reduced."
translations.idiomatic: "Second, merchant tea allotments should be cut."

sentences.zh: 查甘肅茶法，商人每引交茶五十斤，無論本折，即系額課。

translations.literal: "Investigation shows that under Gansu tea law, merchants submit fifty jin of tea per license; whether in kind or commuted, this is the fixed duty."
translations.idiomatic: "Under Gansu law, merchants pay fifty jin of tea per license in kind or cash—that is the fixed duty."

sentences.zh: 外有充公銀三萬九千餘兩，亦系按年交納，無殊正供。

translations.literal: "Besides this there is confiscation silver of more than 39,000 taels, also paid annually, no different from regular revenue."
translations.idiomatic: "There is also an annual confiscation levy of more than 39,000 taels, no less binding than the regular duty."

sentences.zh: 至商人自賣茶封，每引止應配正茶五十斤，連附茶共配售三十餘萬封，商人即以配售之茶納課。

translations.literal: "As for tea packages merchants sell themselves, each license should allot only fifty jin of principal tea; together with supplementary tea, more than 300,000 packages were allotted in all, and merchants used the allotted tea to pay the duty."
translations.idiomatic: "Merchants should receive only fifty jin of principal tea per license for their own sale; with supplementary tea, allotments totaled more than 300,000 packages, which merchants used to pay their duties."

sentences.zh: 經吳達善奏准增配以紓商力，並無課項。

translations.literal: "Wu Dashan memorialized and obtained approval to increase allotments to ease merchants' burden; this involved no additional duty item."
translations.idiomatic: "Wu Dashan had extra allotments approved to ease merchants' burdens, without adding any new levy."

sentences.zh: 第茶封既增，又有搭放兵餉之官茶，勢致愈積愈多，難免停本虧折。

translations.literal: "Only as tea packages increased and official tea was also apportioned for soldiers' pay, the tendency was ever greater accumulation, hard to avoid capital tied up and losses."
translations.idiomatic: "But as allotments grew and official tea was also used for military pay, stock piled up and merchants faced mounting losses."

sentences.zh: 今商人原每引止五封，內應減無課茶十五萬八千三百十六封，共止配茶四十萬九千四百四十封，二成本色茶封既議改徵折價，無庸配運。

translations.literal: "Now merchants originally received only five packages per license; within this, 158,316 packages of duty-free tea should be reduced, totaling only 409,440 allotted packages; since the twenty-percent payment-in-kind tea packages are already deliberated for cash commutation, there is no need to allot and transport them."
translations.idiomatic: "Merchants originally received five packages per license; cut 158,316 duty-free packages, leaving 409,440 in allotments. Since the twenty-percent in-kind levy is to be commuted to cash, those packages need no longer be issued."

sentences.zh: 一，陳積茶封應召商減售也。

translations.literal: "Third, accumulated aged tea packages should summon merchants to sell at reduced price."
translations.idiomatic: "Third, accumulated aged tea should be sold off to merchants at reduced prices."

sentences.zh: 查各司俱有陳茶，而洮司為多。

translations.literal: "Investigation shows every bureau has aged tea, and Taozhou Bureau has the most."
translations.idiomatic: "Every bureau holds aged tea, but Taozhou has the largest stock."

sentences.zh: 現每封四錢發售，商民裹足。

translations.literal: "At present each package is sold at four mace, and merchants and commoners hold back."
translations.idiomatic: "At four mace per package, buyers stay away."

sentences.zh: 請仍照原議，每封定價三錢，召商變賣。

translations.literal: "Request that, still following the original deliberation, each package be fixed at three mace and merchants be summoned to sell it off."
translations.idiomatic: "Restore the original price of three mace per package and invite merchants to buy up the stock."

sentences.zh: 一，內地、新疆應一體搭放也。

translations.literal: "Fourth, the interior and Xinjiang should alike receive apportioned tea."
translations.idiomatic: "Fourth, tea should be apportioned for pay in the interior and Xinjiang alike."

sentences.zh: 查乾隆二十四年吳達善奏准滿、漢各營以茶封搭餉。

translations.literal: "Investigation shows that in Qianlong year 24 Wu Dashan memorialized and obtained approval for Manchu and Han garrisons to receive tea packages in pay."
translations.idiomatic: "In Qianlong 24, Wu Dashan had tea packages approved as pay for Manchu and Han garrisons."

sentences.zh: 至新疆茶斤，向資內地。

translations.literal: "As for tea in Xinjiang, it has always relied on the interior."
translations.idiomatic: "Xinjiang's tea supply has always depended on the interior."

sentences.zh: 今官茶以沿途站車輓運，無庸腳費，其自肅州運至各處，將腳價攤入茶本之內，較之買自商賈，尚多減省。

translations.literal: "Now official tea is transported by relay carts along the route without porter fees; from Suzhou it is carried to each place with transport costs folded into the tea principal, which compared with buying from merchants still saves more."
translations.idiomatic: "Official tea now moves by relay cart without porter fees; transport from Suzhou is folded into the cost and still undercuts merchant prices."

sentences.zh: 」疏入，議行。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted; deliberation approved implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and approved.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，裁甘肅巡撫，茶務歸陝甘總督兼理。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the Gansu governorship was abolished and tea affairs came under the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, the Gansu governorship was abolished and tea affairs passed to the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，以甘省庫貯官茶漸少，復徵本色一成。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, because official tea stored in Gansu warehouses had gradually diminished, collection of ten percent in kind was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, with Gansu's official tea stores running low, collection of ten percent in kind was restored.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，又以伊犁等處安插投誠土爾扈特等眾，賞給茶封，仍議照舊徵收二成。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, because surrendered Torghut and others resettled at Ili and other places were rewarded with tea packages, collection of twenty percent under the old rule was again deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, tea packages granted to resettled Torghuts at Ili and elsewhere led to a return to the old twenty-percent levy.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，四川總督劉秉恬奏准三雜谷等處土司買茶，以千斤為率，使僅敷自食，不能私行轉售。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, Sichuan Governor-General Liu Bingtian memorialized and obtained approval that native offices at Sanzagu and elsewhere buy tea at a rate of one thousand jin, enough only for self-consumption and unable to resell privately.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, Governor-General Liu Bingtian limited native offices at Sanzagu and elsewhere to one thousand jin of tea each—enough for subsistence but not for private resale.

sentences.zh: 四川設邊引，商人納稅領運於松潘等處銷售，無論土司蠻商，俱准赴邊起票販運。

translations.literal: Sichuan established frontier licenses; merchants paid tax and received transport rights to sell at Songpan and other places; whether native offices or frontier merchants, all were permitted to obtain frontier tickets at the border for transport and sale.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan issued frontier licenses for taxed transport to markets such as Songpan; native offices and frontier merchants alike could obtain border permits to trade.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年，以陝西神木官銷茶引久經撥歸甘省商銷，令豁除舊存羨餘名目。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing year 7, because official tea licenses at Shenmu in Shaanxi had long been transferred to Gansu merchant sales, old surplus categories in storage were ordered remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7, with Shenmu's official tea licenses long reassigned to Gansu merchants, old surplus categories on the books were canceled.

sentences.zh: 四川教匪滋擾，蠲除大寧、廣元、太平、通江、南江五州縣茶稅。

translations.literal: When rebel sect insurgents disturbed Sichuan, tea taxes in the five prefectures and counties of Daning, Guangyuan, Taiping, Tongjiang, and Nanjiang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: During the White Lotus rebellion in Sichuan, tea taxes were waived in Daning, Guangyuan, Taiping, Tongjiang, and Nanjiang.

sentences.zh: 十年，復免大寧、太平、通江、巫山四縣廳稅課。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, factory and office taxes in the four counties of Daning, Taiping, Tongjiang, and Wushan were again exempted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, factory and office levies were again waived in Daning, Taiping, Tongjiang, and Wushan.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以甘肅庫茶充羨，定商納官茶，全徵折色。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, because Gansu's warehouse tea overflowed, merchant payment of official tea was fixed entirely as silver commutation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, with Gansu's tea warehouses overflowing, merchants' official tea duties were commuted entirely to silver.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，諭：「閩、皖、浙商人販運武夷、松羅茶赴粵銷售，向由內河行走，近多由海道販運，夾帶違禁貨物私賣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, an edict said: "Merchants of Fujian, Anhui, and Zhejiang transporting Wuyi and Songluo tea to Guangdong for sale formerly traveled by inland waterways; recently many use the sea route, smuggling prohibited goods for private sale."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, an edict noted: "Merchants from Fujian, Anhui, and Zhejiang who ship Wuyi and Songluo tea to Guangdong formerly used inland waterways; many now take the sea route and smuggle contraband."

sentences.zh: 飭令茶商仍由內河行走，永禁出洋販運，違者治罪、茶入官。

translations.literal: "Order tea merchants to travel again by inland waterways; sea transport and sale are permanently forbidden; violators are punished and the tea confiscated."
translations.idiomatic: "Tea merchants must return to inland routes; sea transport is permanently banned, with violators punished and their tea confiscated."

sentences.zh: 道光三年，諭：「那彥成奏定新疆行茶章程，經戶部議覆，烏里雅蘇台、科布多磚茶不得侵越新疆各城售賣。

translations.literal: In Daoguang year 3, an edict said: "Nayancheng memorialized fixing regulations for tea in Xinjiang; after deliberation by the Board of Revenue, brick tea from Uliastai and Kobdo must not encroach on sales in the various cities of Xinjiang."
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 3, an edict cited Nayancheng's Xinjiang tea regulations: after Board of Revenue review, brick tea from Uliastai and Kobdo was barred from competing in Xinjiang's cities.

sentences.zh: 茲將軍果勒豐阿等奏，此項磚茶，由歸化城、張家口請領部票納稅而來，已六十餘年，未便遽行禁止。

translations.literal: "Now Generals Guolefeng'a and others memorialize that this brick tea comes from Guihua and Zhangjiakou with ministry licenses and tax paid, already more than sixty years; it is not convenient to forbid it abruptly."
translations.idiomatic: "Generals Guolefeng'a and others replied that this brick tea has entered with ministry licenses and taxes paid from Guihua and Zhangjiakou for more than sixty years and cannot be banned overnight."

sentences.zh: 惟新疆既為官茶引地，商茶究有礙官引，令嗣後商民每年馱載磚茶一千餘箱，前赴古城，仍照例給票，無許往他處售賣。

translations.literal: "Only since Xinjiang is already territory for official tea licenses, merchant tea after all obstructs official licenses; order that hereafter merchants and commoners each year carry more than a thousand boxes of brick tea to Gucheng, still receiving tickets according to precedent, and not be permitted to sell elsewhere."
translations.idiomatic: "But since Xinjiang is reserved for official tea licenses, private trade does cut into them. Henceforth merchants may carry about a thousand boxes of brick tea annually to Gucheng under the usual permits, and nowhere else."

sentences.zh: 」六年，諭：「前因新疆各城運茶，前將軍等請給引招商納課。

translations.literal: " In the sixth year, an edict said: "Previously, because tea was transported to the various cities of Xinjiang, the former generals and others requested issuing licenses to summon merchants and collect duties."
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6, an edict recalled: "Earlier, generals in Xinjiang had asked to issue licenses and recruit merchants to collect tea duties."

sentences.zh: 茲據慶祥等奏稱，各城無殷實之戶，若遽令承充官商，必致運課兩誤。

translations.literal: "Now according to memorials from Qingxiang and others, each city has no wealthy households; if they are suddenly ordered to serve as official merchants, both transport and duties will certainly fail."
translations.idiomatic: "Qingxiang and others report that Xinjiang's cities lack wealthy merchants; forcing them to serve as official tea contractors would ruin both transport and revenue."

sentences.zh: 著北路商民專運售雜茶，並在古城設局抽稅，即以所收銀抵蘭州茶商課。

translations.literal: "Order merchants on the northern route to transport and sell miscellaneous tea exclusively, and establish a tax office at Gucheng; use the silver collected to offset the duties of Lanzhou tea merchants."
translations.idiomatic: "Northern-route merchants alone should supply miscellaneous tea; a tax office at Gucheng will collect duties to offset Lanzhou merchants' levies."

sentences.zh: 俟試行三年，再行定額。

translations.literal: "After a trial of three years, fixed quotas may then be set."
translations.idiomatic: "After a three-year trial, permanent quotas can be set."

sentences.zh: 至附茶仍由甘商運銷。

translations.literal: "As for supplementary tea, Gansu merchants still transport and sell it."
translations.idiomatic: "Supplementary tea will still be supplied by Gansu merchants."

sentences.zh: 」八年，欽差大臣那彥成言：「甘肅官茶，年例應出關二十餘萬封。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year, Imperial Commissioner Nayancheng said: "Gansu official tea, by annual precedent, should leave the frontier in more than 200,000 packages."
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 8, Imperial Commissioner Nayancheng reported: "Under annual quota, more than 200,000 packages of Gansu official tea should cross the frontier."

sentences.zh: 近來行銷至四五十萬封，皆以無引私茶影射，價復遞加，每附茶一封，售銀七八兩至十餘兩不等。

translations.literal: "Recently sales reach four or five hundred thousand packages, all by unlicensed private tea passed off under cover; prices keep rising, and each package of supplementary tea sells for seven or eight taels to more than ten taels, varying."
translations.idiomatic: "Sales now reach four or five hundred thousand packages, mostly smuggled tea passed off without licenses; prices keep climbing, with supplementary tea selling for seven to ten taels per package or more."

sentences.zh: 請嗣後每封定價，阿克蘇不得過四兩，喀什噶爾不得過五兩，並於嘉峪關外及阿克蘇等處設局稽查。

translations.literal: "Request that hereafter each package be fixed in price: at Aksu no more than four taels, at Kashgar no more than five taels, and inspection offices be established outside Jiayu Pass and at Aksu and other places."
translations.idiomatic: "I ask that prices be capped at four taels per package in Aksu and five in Kashgar, with inspection offices set up beyond Jiayu Pass and in Aksu and elsewhere."

sentences.zh: 」詔如所請。

translations.literal: " The edict granted the request as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved the request.

sentences.zh: 九年，命甘肅茶務責成鎮迪道總司稽查，奇台縣就近經管。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Gansu tea affairs were charged to the Zhendi Circuit intendant for overall inspection and audit; Qitai County was to manage them locally.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 9, responsibility for Gansu tea administration was assigned to the Zhendi Circuit intendant for overall supervision, with Qitai County handling local management.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，閩浙總督王懿德奏請閩省商茶設關徵稅。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng, Min-Zhe Governor-General Wang Yide memorialized requesting that commercial tea in Fujian Province be taxed at newly established passes.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3, Min-Zhe Governor-General Wang Yide asked that commercial tea in Fujian be taxed at customs checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 五年，福建巡撫呂佺孫復言：「閩茶向不頒給執照，徵收課稅。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Fujian Governor Lü Qiansun again said: "Fujian tea has never been issued licenses or subjected to duty collection.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 5, Fujian Governor Lü Qiansun submitted a further memorial: "Fujian tea has never been licensed or taxed.

sentences.zh: 自道光二十九年，直隸督臣訥爾經額以閩商販運，官私莫辨，議由產茶之崇安縣給照，經過關隘，驗稅放行。

translations.literal: Since the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang, Zhili Governor Neerjing'e, because Fujian merchants transported and sold tea and official and private goods could not be distinguished, proposed that Chong'an County, where tea was produced, issue licenses; passing through passes and barriers, taxes would be verified and passage granted.
translations.idiomatic: Since Daoguang 29, Zhili Governor Neerjing'e had proposed that, because Fujian merchants' traffic made official and private tea hard to tell apart, licenses be issued in tea-producing Chong'an County, with taxes verified at passes before release.

sentences.zh: 嗣因產茶不止一處，商人散赴各縣購買，繞道出販，復經撫臣王懿德奏請，自咸豐三年為始，凡出茶之沙、邵武、建安、甌寧、建陽、浦城、崇安等縣，一概就地徵收茶稅，由各縣給照販運，先後下部議准。

translations.literal: Later, because tea was produced in more than one place and merchants scattered to various counties to purchase and sold by detours, Governor Wang Yide again memorialized requesting that, beginning from the third year of Xianfeng, in all tea-exporting counties such as Sha, Shaowu, Jian'an, Ouning, Jianyang, Pucheng, and Chong'an, tea tax be collected on the spot in every case, licenses for transport and sale be issued by each county, and this was approved by the Board in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Tea was soon grown in many counties, and merchants bought it locally and routed it around the checkpoints. Governor Wang Yide memorialized again that from Xianfeng 3 onward, all exporting counties—including Sha, Shaowu, Jian'an, Ouning, Jianyang, Pucheng, and Chong'an—should collect tea tax on the spot and issue transport licenses; the Board approved this in stages.

sentences.zh: 前歲因粵匪竄擾，江、楚茶販不前，暫弛海禁，各路茶販，遂運茶至省，不從各關經過，不特本省減稅，即浙、粵、江西亦形短絀。

translations.literal: The year before last, because Cantonese bandits raided and Jiang and Chu tea merchants did not come forward, the maritime ban was temporarily relaxed; tea merchants on every route then transported tea to the province without passing through the various passes. Not only did this province lose tax revenue; Zhejiang, Guangdong, and Jiangxi also showed shortfalls.
translations.idiomatic: The previous year, with Cantonese rebels on the move and Jiang and Huguang tea traders staying away, the maritime ban was briefly lifted. Tea merchants then brought tea straight to the province without passing the usual checkpoints, cutting not only Fujian's revenue but also leaving Zhejiang, Guangdong, and Jiangxi short.

sentences.zh: 臣履任後，遍詢茶商獲利，較前不啻倍蓰。

translations.literal: After Your servant took office, inquiry among tea merchants showed profits many times greater than before.
translations.idiomatic: Since taking office, I have found tea merchants' profits running many times higher than before.

sentences.zh: 商利益厚，正賦轉虧。

translations.literal: Merchants' profits were thick, while regular revenue turned to loss.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants were prospering while regular tax revenue suffered.

sentences.zh: 現粵匪未平，軍需孔急，眾商身擁厚貲，什一取盈，初無所損。

translations.literal: Now the Cantonese bandits are not yet pacified and military needs are urgently pressing; the many merchants, possessing great wealth, would lose nothing by a tithe.
translations.idiomatic: The Cantonese rebels are still active and military needs are urgent; wealthy merchants would scarcely feel a ten-percent levy.

sentences.zh: 且徵諸販客，不致擾累貧民，完自華商，無慮糾纏洋稅，以天地自然之利，為國家維正之供，迥非加增田賦者比。

translations.literal: Moreover, levying it on traveling merchants would not harass and burden the poor; payment would come from Chinese merchants, with no fear of entanglement over foreign duties; using Heaven and Earth's natural bounty to supply the state's regular revenue was wholly unlike increasing land tax.
translations.idiomatic: The levy would fall on traveling merchants, not the poor; Chinese merchants would pay it, without entangling foreign-duty disputes; and turning nature's bounty into regular state revenue is nothing like raising the land tax.

sentences.zh: 但閩茶不止數縣，必在附省扼要處所設關增卡，給印照以憑查核。

translations.literal: But Fujian tea comes from more than a few counties; passes and additional checkpoints must be established at strategic points near the provincial capital, and stamped licenses issued for verification.
translations.idiomatic: But Fujian tea is not confined to a few counties; checkpoints must be set at strategic points near the capital, with stamped licenses for inspection.

sentences.zh: 連界各省，亦應一體設立，俾免趨避。

translations.literal: Neighboring provinces should also establish them uniformly, so as to prevent evasion by detour.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring provinces should do the same to prevent merchants from routing around the tax.

sentences.zh: 請自咸豐五年始，凡販運茶斤，概行徵稅，所收專款，留支本省兵餉。

translations.literal: I request that from the fifth year of Xianfeng onward, all transported tea by weight be taxed in full; the proceeds, kept as a dedicated fund, be retained to pay this province's military rations.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that from Xianfeng 5 all transported tea be taxed, with the proceeds reserved for this province's military pay.

sentences.zh: 惟創行伊始，多寡未能預定，俟行一二年後，再行比較定額。

translations.literal: Only at the beginning of the new measure the amount could not be fixed in advance; after one or two years of operation, comparison and fixed quotas could then be set.
translations.idiomatic: At first the yield cannot be known; after a year or two of operation, fixed quotas can be set by comparison.

sentences.zh: 」自此閩稅始密。

translations.literal: " From this time Fujian taxation began to be strict.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, Fujian's tea taxes grew stringent.

sentences.zh: 然至十年，猶未報部，經部飭催，乃按期奏報。

translations.literal: Yet by the tenth year it still had not been reported to the Board; after the Board ordered urging, reports were finally submitted on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Even by Xianfeng 10, however, returns had not reached the Board; only after repeated orders from the Board were reports filed on schedule.

sentences.zh: 六年，允伊犁將軍扎拉芬泰請，伊犁產茶，設局徵稅，充伊犁兵餉之用。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the request of Ili General Zhala Fengtai was granted: tea produced in Ili was taxed at an established office to supply Ili military rations.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 6, Ili General Zhala Fengtai's request was approved: an office was set up to tax tea produced in Ili for local military pay.

sentences.zh: 十一年，廣東巡撫覺羅耆齡奏請抽收落地茶稅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Guangdong Governor Jioluo Qiling memorialized requesting collection of local landing tea tax.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 11, Guangdong Governor Jioluo Qiling asked to levy a local tea tax at the point of sale.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，飭下湖南、湖北、江蘇、安徽、江西、浙江、福建各督撫，詳查本省產茶及設茶莊處所，妥議章程具奏。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, orders were sent down to the governors-general and governors of Hunan, Hubei, Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and Fujian to investigate in detail their provinces' tea production and the locations of tea firms, deliberate proper regulations, and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1, the throne ordered the governors of Hunan, Hubei, Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and Fujian to survey tea production and brokerage sites in each province and submit proper regulations.

sentences.zh: 二年，兩江總督曾國籓疏，略言：「江西自咸豐九年，定章分別茶釐、茶捐。

translations.literal: In the second year, Liangjiang Governor-General Zeng Guofan memorialized, stating in summary: "Jiangxi, since the ninth year of Xianfeng, fixed regulations distinguishing tea surtax and tea contribution.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 2, Liangjiang Governor-General Zeng Guofan wrote in summary: "Since Xianfeng 9, Jiangxi has distinguished tea surtax from tea contributions.

sentences.zh: 每百斤除境內抽釐銀二錢，出境又抽一錢五分有零外，向於產茶及設立茶莊處所勸辦茶捐，每百斤捐銀一兩四錢或一兩二錢不等，填給收單，准照籌餉事例匯齊請獎。

translations.literal: Per hundred catties, besides two mace of inland surtax and one mace five candareens and a fraction on exit, tea contributions had been urged at tea-producing places and places where tea firms were established, two taels four mace or two taels two mace per hundred catties, varying; receipts were filled out and, according to the precedent for raising military funds, totals were submitted for rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Besides two mace of inland surtax and one mace five candareens on export per hundred catties, contributions had been solicited at production sites and brokerages at one tael four mace or one tael two mace per hundred catties, with receipts issued and totals submitted for fundraising rewards under precedent.

sentences.zh: 臣仍照舊章辦理。

translations.literal: Your servant still handled matters according to the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: I continued to follow the old rules.

sentences.zh: 本年據九江關署監督蔡錦青詳，請遵照戶部奏准，飭將鹽、茶、竹、木四項統徵關稅，已於三月起徵。

translations.literal: This year, according to a report from Jiujiang Customs acting superintendent Cai Jinqing, requesting compliance with the Board of Revenue's approved memorial, orders were issued to collect customs duty uniformly on salt, tea, bamboo, and timber; collection had begun from the third month.
translations.idiomatic: This year Acting Jiujiang Customs Superintendent Cai Jinqing reported that, following the Board of Revenue's approved plan, unified customs duties on salt, tea, bamboo, and timber had begun in the third month.

sentences.zh: 江西茶葉運至九江，有華商、洋商之分。

translations.literal: When Jiangxi tea reached Jiujiang, there was a distinction between Chinese and foreign merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Tea from Jiangxi reaching Jiujiang was handled differently for Chinese and foreign merchants.

sentences.zh: 洋商既完子口半稅，固不抽釐，華商既納潯關正稅，亦未便再令完釐。

translations.literal: Foreign merchants, having paid transit half-duty, naturally were not surtaxed; Chinese merchants, having paid regular duty at Xun Pass, likewise could not conveniently be made to pay surtax again.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign merchants paid transit half-duty and were exempt from surtax; Chinese merchants paid regular Jiujiang duty and could not reasonably be surtaxed again.

sentences.zh: 臣即照部章，於義寧州開辦落地稅。

translations.literal: Your servant then, according to the Board's regulations, opened local landing tax in Yining Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore opened a local landing tax in Yining Prefecture under the Board's rules.

sentences.zh: 惟原奏內大箱淨茶科則稍重，分別核減。

translations.literal: Only the tariff in the original memorial for large-chest net tea was somewhat heavy; reductions were made by category.
translations.idiomatic: The original tariff for large-chest net tea was somewhat high and was reduced by category.

sentences.zh: 參酌茶捐向章，每百斤，義寧州等處徵一兩四錢，河口鎮徵一兩二錢五分，概充臣營軍餉，由臣刊發稅單護票，委員經收。

translations.literal: Referencing past tea contribution regulations, per hundred catties one tael four mace was levied at Yining Prefecture and other places, and one tael two mace five candareens at Hekou Town; all was applied to Your servant's camp military rations, with tax receipts and transit passes printed and issued by Your servant and collected by appointed officials.
translations.idiomatic: Drawing on past contribution rates, one tael four mace per hundred catties was levied at Yining and elsewhere, and one tael two mace five candareens at Hekou Town, all for my camp's military pay; I issued tax receipts and transit passes for collection by appointed officers.

sentences.zh: 或業戶自行完納，或茶莊代為完稅領單，至發販時，統由茶莊繳銷稅單。

translations.literal: Either growers paid themselves, or tea firms paid tax on their behalf and received receipts; at the time of wholesale, tax receipts were uniformly surrendered by the tea firms.
translations.idiomatic: Growers might pay directly, or brokerages might pay and take receipts; on resale, brokerages would surrender the tax receipts.

sentences.zh: 華商換給護票，洋商即憑運照，販至各處銷售。

translations.literal: Chinese merchants were given transit passes in exchange; foreign merchants relied on transport permits and sold to various places.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese merchants received transit passes; foreign merchants used transport permits to sell wherever they traded.

sentences.zh: 除華商完納九江關稅、洋商完納子口半稅外，經過江西、安徽各釐卡，驗明放行。

translations.literal: Apart from Chinese merchants paying Jiujiang customs duty and foreign merchants paying transit half-duty, passing through Jiangxi and Anhui surtax stations, they were verified and released.
translations.idiomatic: Once Chinese merchants had paid Jiujiang duty and foreign merchants transit half-duty, they passed Jiangxi and Anhui surtax stations on verification alone.

sentences.zh: 如此辦理，與戶部原奏、總理衙門條約，一一符合。

translations.literal: Handled thus, it accorded item by item with the Board of Revenue's original memorial and the Zongli Yamen's treaties.
translations.idiomatic: This arrangement matched the Board of Revenue's original plan and the Zongli Yamen treaties point for point.

sentences.zh: 稅單雖系茶莊經手，稅銀實為業戶所出。

translations.literal: Although tax receipts were handled by tea firms, the tax silver in fact came from growers.
translations.idiomatic: Brokerages handled the receipts, but growers paid the tax.

sentences.zh: 洋商不得藉口於子口半稅，而禁中國之業戶不完中國之地稅。

translations.literal: Foreign merchants could not use transit half-duty as a pretext to forbid Chinese growers from paying Chinese local tax.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign transit half-duty could not be used as a pretext to exempt Chinese growers from local Chinese taxes.

sentences.zh: 華商既免逢卡抽釐，亦不至紛紛私買運照，冒充洋商。

translations.literal: Chinese merchants, being exempt from repeated surtax at every station, would also not all privately buy transport permits and pose as foreign merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese merchants, freed from repeated checkpoint surtaxes, would no longer buy foreign transport permits in secret and pose as foreign traders.

sentences.zh: 」得旨允行。

translations.literal: " An edict granted approval for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 五年，戶部奏准甘省引滯課懸，暫於陝西省城設官茶總店，潼關、商州、漢中設分店。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Board of Revenue approved that because Gansu transport permits lagged and duties remained outstanding, an official tea main store was temporarily established in Shaanxi provincial capital, with branch stores at Tong Pass, Shangzhou, and Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5, the Board approved temporary official tea shops in Shaanxi— a main store in the provincial capital and branches at Tong Pass, Shangzhou, and Hanzhong—because Gansu licenses lagged and duties were in arrears.

sentences.zh: 商販無引之茶，到陝呈報。

translations.literal: Tea transported by merchants without licenses was reported on arrival in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Unlicensed tea brought by merchants was reported on arrival in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 上色茶百斤收課銀一兩，中色六錢，下色四錢。

translations.literal: Top-grade tea: one tael of duty silver per hundred catties; middle grade six mace; lower grade four mace.
translations.idiomatic: Top-grade tea was taxed one tael per hundred catties, middle grade six mace, and lower grade four mace.

sentences.zh: 所收解甘彌補欠課。

translations.literal: What was collected was remitted to Gansu to make up outstanding duties.
translations.idiomatic: Proceeds were sent to Gansu to cover arrears.

sentences.zh: 七年，議准歸化城商人販茶至恰克圖，假道俄邊，前赴西洋各國通商，請領部照，比照張家口減半，令交銀二十五兩，每票不得過萬二千斤。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, it was approved that merchants of Guihuacheng transporting tea to Kyakhta by way of the Russian border to trade with Western countries should request Board licenses, compared with Zhangjiakou at half rate, paying twenty-five taels of silver, with no single permit exceeding twelve thousand catties.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7, Guihuacheng merchants carrying tea to Kyakhta via Russia to trade with Western countries were allowed Board licenses at half the Zhangjiakou rate—twenty-five taels per permit, capped at twelve thousand catties.

sentences.zh: 十一年，議准甘省積欠舊課，仍追舊商。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, it was approved that Gansu's accumulated old outstanding duties should still be pursued from the old merchants.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 11, it was ruled that Gansu's accumulated old duties would still be collected from the original merchants.

sentences.zh: 召募之新商試新課。

translations.literal: Newly recruited merchants would trial the new duties.
translations.idiomatic: Newly recruited merchants would pay under the new schedule.

sentences.zh: 其雜課、養廉、充公、官禮四項緩徵。

translations.literal: The four items of miscellaneous duties, integrity-support payments, confiscation payments, and official courtesy payments were deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous duties, integrity-support fees, confiscation payments, and official courtesy fees were deferred.

sentences.zh: 十三年，議准甘省仿淮鹽之例，以票代引，不分各省商販，均令先納正課，始准給票。
